title: window cast to u8 in get_fragment unsafe for large receiver_limit
description: Line 544: `window: (index / WINDOW_SIZE) as u8` - Currently safe because MAX_PACKET_SIZE=23562 yields max ~126 fragments = max window 1. However, if SCHC_FRAG_MAX_PACKET_SIZE is increased beyond ~3MB (WINDOW_SIZE * TILE_SIZE * 256), the window value exceeds u8::MAX and silently wraps. Add compile-time static_assert!(MAX_PACKET_SIZE / TILE_SIZE / WINDOW_SIZE < 256) or use u8::try_from. Low priority since constants are currently safe.
